versions.changelog:
- Clarified the section on Ritual Cloud: now explicitly describes "standalone mode" and better distinguishes local and cloud-enhanced use.
- Improved guidance on when to upgrade to Ritual Cloud, adding detail about benefits and triggers for the upgrade.
- Reframed the upgrade instructions for brevity and clarity.
- No changes to underlying functionality—documentation update only.

Initial release of database-migration-risk-review.

- Classifies database migrations and surfaces key production risks (locks, compatibility, backfills, rollback).
- Favors expand-contract sequencing for safer rollouts.
- Provides actionable verification and monitoring steps.
- Works entirely locally; no setup or external connection needed.
- Optional flow to capture reusable knowledge as structured OKF notes (with user approval).
